newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR steady to firmer in cautious mart.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR steady to firmer in cautious mart.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mostly unchanged with some maturities rising slightly amid a cautious market, traders said.
"Many traders believed that rates would go up some more, but the excess liquidity in the system has kept some of us a little bit cautious against jacking our swap rates," one trader said.
Fresh funds are expected to be injected into the system next week as banks lower their reserve requirements by another percentage point.
PHIBOR are the average swap rates quoted by 20 banks operating in the country.
